words.gloss: in difficulty over a present need

hindi: जिसके पास कोश नहीं है और जो तत्काल उत्पन्न प्रयोजन के कारण कठिनाई में है, वह कोश का संग्रह करे।
english: One who has no treasury and is in difficulty over a present need should gather a treasury.
notes: No subject is stated; 'one' is the implied subject of the optative. pratyutpanna-artha-kṛcchra: 'difficulty over a present (immediate) need'; artha could also be 'wealth/money', so 'in straits for present wealth' is an alternative.

hindi: वह बड़े अथवा छोटे विस्तार वाले, वर्षा पर निर्भर न रहने वाले और प्रचुर अन्न वाले जनपद से अन्न का तीसरा अथवा चौथा भाग माँगे — गुणवत्ता के अनुसार मध्यम अथवा निम्न।
english: He should ask a country that is large, or of small extent, not dependent on rain and with abundant grain, for a third or a fourth share of the grain, according to quality, middling or lower.
notes: adeva-mātṛka is literally 'not having the god (rain-god) as its mother', i.e. not dependent on rain. yathā-sāram: 'according to its quality/substance'; sāra could also be 'strength' or 'yield'. 'madhyam avaram vā' is neuter, so it cannot agree with the masculine janapadam or aṃśam; taken here as an adverbial 'middling or lower' (degree of the share); it might instead qualify the country's quality. The units of grammar and the sense of the last phrase are uncertain. Reading of madhyam avaram vā accepted as adverbial (middling or lower) with doubt; sāra may also mean strength or capacity of the country. No firm sense; a person should check against Kangle.
lines_deva: जन.पदं महान्तम् अल्प.प्रमाणं वा-अदेव.मातृकं प्रभूत.धान्यं धान्यस्य-अंशं तृतीयं चतुर्थं वा याचेत, यथा.सारं मध्यम् अवरं वा
lines_iast: jana.padaṃ mahāntam alpa.pramāṇaṃ vā-adeva.mātṛkaṃ prabhūta.dhānyaṃ dhānyasya-aṃśaṃ tṛtīyaṃ caturthaṃ vā yāceta, yathā.sāraṃ madhyam avaraṃ vā

words.gloss: work in the forests of materials and elephants

hindi: जो दुर्ग और सेतु के कार्य, व्यापारिक मार्गों, निर्जन भूमि की बसावट, खानों तथा द्रव्य और हाथियों के वनों के कार्य में उपयोगी हो, ऐसे सीमान्त से अथवा छोटे विस्तार वाले से वह याचना न करे।
english: He should not ask [for a share] from a frontier [country] that is useful for work on forts and embankments, trade routes, the settling of empty [land], mines, and work in the forests of materials and elephants, or from [one] of small extent.
notes: The long compound is one word running over the line break marked '.-'; it is split here into five groups: durga-setu-karma / vaṇik-patha / śūnya-niveśa / khani / dravya-hasti-vana-karma. The grouping is a judgment: karma occurs twice, and dravya-vana ('forest of materials') and hasti-vana ('elephant forest') are read as the two forests. Alternative: 'karma' of the first group governs only forts and embankments, while the final karma governs the forests. 'country' is supplied from the previous unit. Review: the draft groups the long compound in five chunks (a hyphenated chunk is one word entry) instead of one entry per member; accepted as readable, flagged for a person. Alternative reading: karma governs every member (work on forts, embankments, trade routes, ..., material forests, elephant forests).
lines_deva: दुर्ग.सेतु.कर्म.वणिक्.पथ.शून्य.निवेश.खनि.द्रव्य.हस्ति.वन.कर्म.- उपकारिणं प्रत्यन्तम् अल्प.प्रमाणं वा न याचेत
lines_iast: durga.setu.karma.vaṇik.patha.śūnya.niveśa.khani.dravya.hasti.vana.karma.- upakāriṇaṃ pratyantam alpa.pramāṇaṃ vā na yāceta

words.gloss: grain, cattle, gold and so on
words.gram: dvandva with ādi, n. acc. sg.
pres. part. mid. ni-√viś, m. dat. sg.

hindi: अनाज, पशु, सोना आदि बसने वाले को दे।
english: He should give grain, cattle, gold and the like to one who is settling.

hindi: अनाजों का बीज और भोजन से शुद्ध चौथा भाग भी सोने से खरीदे।
english: He should also buy with gold a fourth share of the grains, clear of seed and food.
notes: The placement of 'ca' after śuddham is unusual; rendered 'also', linking this purchase to the request in the earlier units. bīja-bhakta-śuddha: 'clear of seed and food', i.e. after deducting the portions kept for sowing and for food (the deduction itself is not spelled out).
lines_deva: चतुर्थम् अंशं धान्यानां बीज.भक्त.शुद्धं च हिरण्येन क्रीणीयात्
lines_iast: caturtham aṃśaṃ dhānyānāṃ bīja.bhakta.śuddhaṃ ca hiraṇyena krīṇīyāt

hindi: वन में उत्पन्न वस्तु और श्रोत्रिय के धन को छोड़ दे।
english: He should spare what is born in the forest and the property of a śrotriya (one learned in the Veda).
notes: pari-√hṛ is 'avoid, leave out, exempt'; here 'spare' means exempt from the levy.

hindi: उसे भी अनुग्रह से खरीदे।
english: Even that he should buy as a favour.
notes: anugraha: 'favour, indulgence'; the text does not say whether the favour is to the seller or on favourable terms.

hindi: अथवा उसके न किए जाने पर समाहर्ता के पुरुष ग्रीष्म ऋतु में किसानों का उद्वाप करवाएँ।
english: Or, if that is not done, the Collector's men should have the udvāpa of the farmers carried out in summer.
notes: udvāpa is an obscure term, left untranslated; literally ud-√vap is 'sowing/scattering out' and the sense (extra sowing, a levy, or removal of seed) is uncertain. 'tasya' (of that) refers back to the purchase or request of the previous units, not certain. Review: udvāpa and tasya both left open; kept literal, no sense built (confidence low is right).
lines_deva: तस्य-अकरणे वा समाहर्तृ.पुरुषा ग्रीष्मे कर्षकाणाम् उद्वापं कारयेयुः
lines_iast: tasya-akaraṇe vā samāhartṛ.puruṣā grīṣme karṣakāṇām udvāpaṃ kārayeyuḥ

words.gram: pres. part. ud-ā-√hṛ, m. nom. pl.

hindi: प्रमाद से चूकने वाले का अत्यय दुगुना बताते हुए वे बीज बोने के समय बीज का लेखा बनाएँ।
english: Declaring the penalty (atyaya) of one who has lapsed through negligence to be double, they should make a seed record at seed-time.
notes: atyaya: 'penalty' (alternatives: 'loss, offence'); the same word is used in unit 13. avaskanna: 'fallen, slipped, lapsed'. bīja-lekhya: literally 'seed writing', a written record of seed.
lines_deva: प्रमाद.अवस्कन्नस्य-अत्ययं द्वि.गुणम् उदाहरन्तो बीज.काले बीज.लेख्यं कुर्युः
lines_iast: pramāda.avaskannasya-atyayaṃ dvi.guṇam udāharanto bīja.kāle bīja.lekhyaṃ kuryuḥ

words.gloss: for worship of gods and ancestors and giving

hindi: निष्पन्न हो जाने पर वे हरे और पके का लिया जाना रोकें, शाक-कट-भङ्ग और मुष्टि को छोड़कर, देवताओं और पितरों की पूजा तथा दान के लिए अथवा गायों के लिए।
english: When [the crop] is ready, they should prevent the taking of [what is] green and ripe, except for śāka-kaṭa-bhaṅga and a fistful (muṣṭi), for the purpose of worship of gods and ancestors and of giving, or for the purpose of cows.
notes: The noun with niṣpanne is not stated; 'the crop' is supplied in brackets. śāka-kaṭa-bhaṅga is obscure and left untranslated (literally 'vegetable, mat/straw?, breaking'). The ending -bhyām is dual, so two things are excepted: [śāka-kaṭa-bhaṅga] and [muṣṭi]; an alternative division is [śāka-kaṭa] and [bhaṅga-muṣṭi]. gava-artham: gava is the unsandhied stem of go (cow). The final purpose phrases may govern only the exceptions or the whole prohibition. Review: the printed -bhyāṃ is the dual ablative (anyatra takes the ablative), so two exceptions are read; the grouping of the first four members as one word in the split is the drafter's judgment (not every member listed separately). The Hindi/English wording of the final purpose phrases leaves open whether they limit only the exceptions.
lines_deva: निष्पन्ने हरित.पक्व.आदानं वारयेयुः, अन्यत्र शाक.कट.भङ्ग.मुष्टिभ्यां देव.पितृ.पूजा.दान.अर्थं गव.अर्थं वा
lines_iast: niṣpanne harita.pakva.ādānaṃ vārayeyuḥ, anyatra śāka.kaṭa.bhaṅga.muṣṭibhyāṃ deva.pitṛ.pūjā.dāna.arthaṃ gava.arthaṃ vā

hindi: भिक्षुकों और ग्राम के भृतकों के लिए वे राशि के मूल को छोड़ दें।
english: And they should spare the base of the heap for the sake of mendicants and village hirelings.
notes: Division of the compound is uncertain: 'mendicants and village hirelings' (grāma-bhṛtaka as one member) is taken; alternative 'mendicants, the village, and hired men'. rāśi-mūla: 'base (foot) of the heap', i.e. the lowest part or root amount of the grain heap; exact sense not stated.

words.gloss: of one who carries off his own crop

hindi: अपनी फसल का अपहरण करने वाले का प्रतिपात आठ गुना है।
english: For one who carries off his own crop, the pratipāta [is] eightfold.
notes: pratipāta is left untranslated: literally 'falling back'; it is probably a recovery or penalty falling on the offender, but the sense is uncertain. 'his own crop' (sva-sasya) may mean the farmer's own produce; the possessor is not specified.

words.gloss: of one who carries off another's crop

hindi: दूसरे की फसल का अपहरण करने वाले का सीता-अत्यय पचास गुना है, अपने वर्ग के लिए; किन्तु बाहरी के लिए वध है।
english: For one who carries off another's crop, the sītā-atyaya [is] fiftyfold, for one of his own group; but for an outsider [it is] death.
notes: sītā-atyaya: sītā is literally 'furrow' (often the king's own cultivated land); atyaya is 'penalty/loss' as in unit 9. The exact meaning of the compound is uncertain and is not resolved. The two genitives sva-vargasya and bāhyasya are read as 'for (one of) his own group' and 'for an outsider'.
lines_deva: पर.सस्य.अपहारिणः पञ्चाशद्.गुणः सीता.अत्ययः, स्व.वर्गस्य, बाह्यस्य तु वधः
lines_iast: para.sasya.apahāriṇaḥ pañcāśad.guṇaḥ sītā.atyayaḥ, sva.vargasya, bāhyasya tu vadhaḥ

hindi: वे अनाजों का चौथा भाग और वन्य उत्पादों का छठा भाग ग्रहण करें — रुई, लाक्षा, क्षौम, वल्कल, कपास, रौम, कौशेय, औषध, गन्ध, पुष्प, फल, शाक, इन सबके पण्य का तथा काष्ठ, बाँस, मांस और सूखे मांस का — और दाँत तथा चर्म का आधा।
english: They should take a fourth share of grains and a sixth of forest products — of wares of cotton-down, lac, linen, bark, cotton, rauma, silk, medicinal herbs, perfumes, flowers, fruit and vegetables, and of timber, bamboo, meat and dried meat — and half of tooth and hide.

text_flags.why: possible typo: 'kauṣadha' is not a word; the sandhi kauśeya + auṣadha gives kauśeyauṣadha, so an extra 'k' may have been typed; 'medicinal herb' fits the list of products

notes: The long dvandva continues across the line break '.-' into puṣpa.phala.śāka.paṇyānāṃ. rauma is obscure (alternatives: woollen product, or a kind of salt); left untranslated. tūla literally 'cotton-down/tuft'. vallūra 'dried meat' (dictionary sense). danta 'tooth' is probably ivory but is rendered literally. paṇyānām is read as ending the compound 'wares of ...'. The corrected reading auṣadha is used in the words and translation. Review: kauṣadha accepted as a probable typo for auṣadha (kauśeya + auṣadha), kept as a possible typo; a person should check the printed edition. rauma stays untranslated (woollen product or a salt are only guesses).
lines_deva: चतुर्थम् अंशं धान्यानां षष्ठं वन्यानां तूल.लाक्षा.क्षौम.वल्क.कार्पास.रौम.कौशेय.कौषध.गन्ध.- पुष्प.फल.शाक.पण्यानां काष्ठ.वेणु.मांस.वल्लूराणां च गृह्णीयुः, दन्त.अजिनस्य-अर्धम्
lines_iast: caturtham aṃśaṃ dhānyānāṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ vanyānāṃ tūla.lākṣā.kṣauma.valka.kārpāsa.rauma.kauśeya.kauṣadha.gandha.- puṣpa.phala.śāka.paṇyānāṃ kāṣṭha.veṇu.māṃsa.vallūrāṇāṃ ca gṛhṇīyuḥ, danta.ajinasya-ardham

words.gram: pres. part. mid. vi-√krī, m. gen. sg.

hindi: उस न छोड़े हुए को बेचने वाले का पहला साहस-दण्ड है।
english: For one who sells that when it has not been released, [there is] the first fine for rashness (sāhasa).
notes: anisṛṣṭa: 'not released/not permitted' (for sale); who must release it is not stated. pūrvaḥ sāhasa-daṇḍaḥ: the first (lowest) of the graded rashness fines, rendered literally as 'the first fine for rashness'.

hindi: यह किसानों के विषय में याचना है।
english: Such is the request (praṇaya) among farmers.
notes: A closing summary formula, not a quoted view, so 'iti' is rendered 'such is'. praṇaya: 'request, solicitation' (also 'affection/trust'); the term should be settled in the glossary. The same formula closes units 26 and 29. Glossary (5.2): praṇaya = request (याचना); closing "iti X-eṣu praṇayaḥ" = "Such is the request (praṇaya) among X" / "यह X के विषय में याचना है"; iti rendered "such is", never a bare "thus".

hindi: सोना, चाँदी, हीरा, मणि, मोती, मूँगा, घोड़े और हाथी का व्यापार करने वाले पचास के कर वाले हैं।
english: Traders in gold, silver, diamonds, gems, pearls, coral, horses and elephants [pay] a tax of fifty.
notes: X-paṇya is a bahuvrīhi 'whose wares are X', rendered 'traders in X'. pañcāśat-kara is 'having fifty as the tax'; the unit of the fifty (a share or a sum) is not stated. vajra here is the trade item (diamond), literally 'thunderbolt'.

hindi: सूत, वस्त्र, ताँबा, वृत्त, काँसा, गन्ध, औषधि और शीधु का व्यापार करने वाले चालीस के कर वाले हैं।
english: Traders in thread, cloth, copper, vṛtta, bell-metal, perfumes, medicines and śīdhu liquor [pay] a tax of forty.
notes: vṛtta is obscure here (literally 'round'; possibly a metal or alloy) and is left untranslated. śīdhu is a kind of liquor (dictionary: distilled from sugar-cane). kaṃsa 'bell-metal' (alternatives: bronze, a vessel).

words.gloss: those who do business with carts

hindi: अनाज, रस और लोहे का व्यापार करने वाले तथा गाड़ियों से व्यवहार करने वाले तीस के कर वाले हैं।
english: Traders in grain, juices and iron, and those who do business with carts, [pay] a tax of thirty.
notes: rasa: 'juice/liquid' (here not 'poison', which is the glossary sense only in poisoning contexts). loha: 'iron' (could be metal in general). śakaṭa-vyavahārin: 'those who do business with carts' (alternatives: cart traders, cart carriers).

words.gloss: those who do business in glass

hindi: काँच का व्यवहार करने वाले और बड़े कारीगर बीस के कर वाले हैं।
english: Those who do business in glass and the major craftsmen [pay] a tax of twenty.
notes: kāca: 'glass' (alternatively crystal).

hindi: छोटे कारीगर और बन्धकियों के पोषक दस के कर वाले हैं।
english: Minor craftsmen and those who maintain bandhakīs (unchaste women) [pay] a tax of ten.
notes: bandhakī: dictionary 'unchaste woman, harlot'; the text itself does not explain the term. poṣaka 'one who maintains/supports'.

words.gram: f.; first member of tat-puruṣa mṛd-bhāṇḍa
adj.; first member of karmadhāraya pakva-anna

hindi: लकड़ी, बाँस, पत्थर, मिट्टी के बर्तन, पका अन्न और हरी वस्तुओं का व्यापार करने वाले पाँच के कर वाले हैं।
english: Traders in wood, bamboo, stone, earthen vessels, cooked food and green [produce] [pay] a tax of five.
notes: mṛd-bhāṇḍa is read as 'earthen vessels'; pakva-anna 'cooked food'; harita 'green things' (vegetables or fresh produce), rendered 'green [produce]'.

hindi: कुशीलव और रूपाजीवाएँ वेतन का आधा दें।
english: Actors and courtesans should give half of their wages.
notes: kuśīlava: 'actor, bard, minstrel'. rūpa-ājīva (rūpājīvā) = courtesan per the glossary (literally 'living by beauty'). 'their' is implied by the genitive sense of vetana-ardham.

hindi: काम के योग्य लोगों से सोने का कर मँगवाएँ, और इनके किसी भी अपराध को छोड़ न दें।
english: They should have those fit for work bring a tax in gold, and they should not let off any offence of these.
notes: karmaṇya: 'fit for work, active'; it may mean 'able-bodied' or 'employed'. The causative takes a double accusative here (those fit for work; the gold tax). 'eṣām' (of these) probably refers to the persons in the preceding units; this is not certain.
lines_deva: हिरण्य.करं कर्मण्यान् आहारयेयुः, न च-एषां कञ्चिद् अपराधं परिहरेयुः
lines_iast: hiraṇya.karaṃ karmaṇyān āhārayeyuḥ, na ca-eṣāṃ kañcid aparādhaṃ parihareyuḥ

words.gloss: what has not been taken up

hindi: क्योंकि वे अपरिगृहीत को आगे लाकर बेच सकते हैं।
english: For, having brought forward what has not been taken up (aparigṛhīta), they might sell [it].
notes: Obscure; rendered literally. aparigṛhīta: 'not taken up/accepted/appropriated' (possibly 'unowned' or, of a woman, 'not taken as wife'); the object is not stated. abhi-√nī: 'lead forward, bring up', or 'act out, perform' (of actors). The antecedent of 'te' is not certain; no sense is firmly built.

hindi: यह व्यवहारियों के विषय में याचना है।
english: Such is the request (praṇaya) among traders.
notes: Closing summary formula, as in unit 16. vyavahārin is 'one who does business'. Glossary (5.2): praṇaya = request (याचना), as in unit 16.

hindi: मुर्गे और सूअर के विषय में आधा दे; छोटे पशु छठा भाग दें; और गाय, भैंस, खच्चर, गधे और ऊँट दसवाँ भाग दें।
english: [As for] fowls and pigs, he should give half; small livestock [should give] a sixth part; and cows, buffaloes, mules, donkeys and camels a tenth part.
notes: The text is elliptical: what the half, sixth and tenth are shares of (the animals or their increase) and who gives is not stated. 'kukkuṭa-sūkaram' is a neuter singular collective dvandva. The verb 'give' is carried over to the later clauses.
lines_deva: कुक्कुट.सूकरम् अर्धं दद्यात्, क्षुद्र.पशवः षड्.भागम्, गो.महिष.अश्वतर.खर.उष्ट्राश् च दश.भागम्
lines_iast: kukkuṭa.sūkaram ardhaṃ dadyāt, kṣudra.paśavaḥ ṣaḍ.bhāgam, go.mahiṣa.aśvatara.khara.uṣṭrāś ca daśa.bhāgam

words.gloss: of the highest beauty and youth

hindi: बन्धकियों के पोषक राजा की परम रूप और यौवन वाली दासियों द्वारा कोश का संग्रह करें।
english: Those who maintain bandhakīs should gather the treasury through the king's maidservants of the highest beauty and youth.
notes: saṃ-√hṛ: 'gather, bring together'. preṣyā 'maidservant, female servant'. The means ('through') is the instrumental; how the treasury is gathered through them is not stated.

hindi: यह योनि-पोषकों के विषय में याचना है।
english: Such is the request (praṇaya) among those who maintain yoni.
notes: yoni-poṣaka is obscure; rendered literally ('maintainers of yoni': womb, source, or breeding stock). It may sum up unit 27 (breeders of animals) and 28; no sense is built. Glossary (5.2): praṇaya = request (याचना), as in unit 16. yoni-poṣaka stays literal; no sense built.

hindi: केवल एक बार प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए, दो बार नहीं।
english: [It] is to be applied only once, not twice.
notes: The subject is not stated; probably the request/levy just described.

hindi: अथवा उसके न किए जाने पर समाहर्ता कार्य का हवाला देकर पौरों और जानपदों से भिक्षा माँगे।
english: Or, if that is not done, the Collector, alleging a task, should beg of the citizens and country people.
notes: apa-√diś: 'allege, give as a pretext/reason'. 'tasya' refers to the earlier request or levy.
lines_deva: तस्य-अकरणे वा समाहर्ता कार्यम् अपदिश्य पौर.जानपदान् भिक्षेत
lines_iast: tasya-akaraṇe vā samāhartā kāryam apadiśya paura.jānapadān bhikṣeta

hindi: और गुप्त पुरुष यहाँ पहले बहुत अधिक दें।
english: And the secret agents should give here first, excessively.
notes: yoga-puruṣa = secret agent per the glossary. atimātram: 'beyond measure, in excess'.

hindi: इस निर्देश से राजा पौरों और जानपदों से भिक्षा माँगे।
english: By this indication the king should beg of the citizens and country people.
notes: pradeśa: 'pointing out, indication, example'; the phrase means the king may follow the procedure just indicated (the Collector's way); another sense is 'rule by extension/analogy'.

words.gram: pres. part. pra-√yam, m. acc. pl.

hindi: और कापटिक इन थोड़ा देने वालों की निन्दा करें।
english: And the kāpaṭikas (literally 'deceitful ones') should revile these [people] when they give little.
notes: kāpaṭika is literally 'deceitful one, fraud'; its technical sense here (a class of agent) is not stated by the text and is not asserted. 'these' = the citizens and country people of the previous units.

hindi: अथवा सार के अनुसार धनवानों से सोना माँगे, अथवा उपकार के अनुसार, अथवा जो वे अपनी इच्छा से भेंट करें।
english: Or he should ask gold of the wealthy according to [their] substance, or according to the benefit, or whatever they may offer of their own accord.
notes: sārataḥ: 'by substance, according to (their) means'; sāra could also be 'strength'. yathā-upakāram: 'according to the benefit/service'; whose benefit is not stated. sva-vaśa: 'under their own control', i.e. willingly.
lines_deva: सारतो वा हिरण्यम् आढ्यान् याचेत, यथा.उपकारं वा, स्व.वशा वा यद् उपहरेयुः
lines_iast: sārato vā hiraṇyam āḍhyān yāceta, yathā.upakāraṃ vā, sva.vaśā vā yad upahareyuḥ
